_readme: Calls: tokens separated by ', '. Trap steps separated by ' | '. Numbers only for 1-4 in offence; incoming attacks are words and are spoken by a different voice ('Incoming cross!'). Every token, incoming attack and spoken line becomes an audio clip: run tools/build_audio.py after editing, then tools/build_library_md.py (it also audits every combo).

combos.why: The jab measures and blinds; the cross travels down the same line.
The double jab steals distance, and the second jab hides the cross.
Jab high lifts the guard; the cross goes under it to the body.
Jab to the body drops the hands; the cross goes to the open chin.
The up jab splits the guard from below; the cross follows through the gap.
The normal jab makes them shell high; the up jab comes under the gloves.
Touch with the up jab from range and leave before they can answer.
Land the one two and leave on an angle. Never stay to admire it.
The jab feint freezes them; the cross lands while they are still reacting.
Fake the cross so they cover; jab and cross land as they open back up.
Finishing on the jab keeps them on the end of your reach while you reset.
Same cross on two levels: they can only guard one of them.
The teep after the cross pushes them straight back out to your range.
The teep stops their step; the jab and cross catch them while they reset.
The jab lifts their hands and eyes; the teep lands in the open belly.
A jab feint makes them lift the guard; drive the cross into the body.
Jab and angle off: they reset facing an empty spot.
Pumping jabs set a rhythm; the cross breaks it.
A long cross from outside, then leave on the angle before they answer.
The body cross pulls their elbows down; the up jab rises straight through.
Four straights: every hand comes straight back to the face.
The double jab: the first finds the range, the second scores.
Body then head with the same hand: the eyes follow the first one down.
In MMA a level change sells the takedown; the cross lands as they sprawl.
They move away from the cross into the hook. Then you leave.
The lead hook pulls their guard wide; the cross goes down the middle, then step out.
Cross, hook, cross turns them; pivot out so they punch where you were.
The hook to the liver drops their elbow; the same hook goes up top. Then leave.
Punish on the inside, then angle off before they can clinch or trade.
Your jab invites their jab back; pull just out of range and fire the cross over it.
Let their punch fall short, then hit the space it left open.
Pull, then cross and hook while they are overextended. Then leave.
After the miss they are stretched out; jab and cross before they recover.
A missed punch leaves the body open; drive the cross into it.
The up jab comes up under their returning hand; the cross follows.
The cross loads your hips; ride that turn into the lead head kick.
The feint draws their counter; pull out of it and punish.
They answer your one two; pull out of it and cross again.
Counter, then pivot: they turn into nothing.
Slip outside their jab and your cross is already loaded.
Slip outside, cross over the top, hook behind it.
Roll under the hook and come back with your own hook and cross.
The rear hand parries their jab, so your lead hand is free: jab back, then the cross.
If they keep walking after the miss, teep them back to range.
After the pull your weight is on the back leg, so the lead leg is free to kick.
Pull, and come back with the lead hook as they reach.
Stepping back draws them in; the cross meets them on the step.
Pull from the one two and fire your cross as their second hand comes back.
Bait, pull, punish, leave. The whole sniper game in one combo.
The body cross pulls their elbow down; the rear kick goes over it to the head.
combos.ok: rear hand into rear kick on purpose: Milan's favourite, the body cross dips the hips and the kick comes off that dip

combos.why: The cross turns your hips; let the lead leg ride that turn up to the head.
The jab raises their eyes; the rear low kick lands where they aren't looking.
The jab blinds them; the rear head kick comes around the side.
The teep makes them guard the middle; the head kick goes around it.
The lead hook turns them and reloads your hips; the rear kick lands on the open side.
Fake the kick so they lift the leg; the cross lands while they stand on one foot.
The up jab splits the guard upward; the head kick comes around it.
The lead kick to the body brings their elbow down; the cross follows straight.
Dutch style: punches up top hide the low kick finish.
The calf kick makes them shift their weight; the cross catches them flat.
The hook pulls their guard to one side; the rear kick lands on the other.
Fake the cross so they cover the centre; the lead kick comes around the side.
The cross turns you; the lead kick lands on the liver side.
The low kick drops their eyes; the cross follows up top.
The body jab pulls their hands down; the lead leg goes high.
Teep to set range, cross to turn them, lead kick to finish on the open side.

combos.calls: feint low kick, rear head kick
combos.why: Fake low, go high: their guard follows the fake down.
The teep stops them; jab and cross land while they come back in.
A shoulder twitch costs nothing and makes them react; the one two lands on the reaction.
The hook turns their head into the line of the last cross.
Cross, hook, cross: each punch loads the next one.
Close range is punish and exit: the hook turns them, the elbow comes across, then you leave.
If the cross gets you too close, turn it into a lead elbow and pivot off the line.
Cross and hook bend them over; the knee comes up the middle. Short knee, the bag moves.
McGregor's back-skip: hop back and to your right, and the 2 meets them as they square up chasing.
When they overextend on the answer, the lead hook catches them. Adesanya finished Whittaker this way.
Pull from the punch, then the lead hook as you pivot: they fall into it and you are already off the line.
Jab to make them answer, back-skip out of the answer, 2 on the way in.

combos.cue: Sell it with the shoulder. Kick the second they react.
combos.why: Adesanya's shoulder feint makes them guard high; the lead kick goes to the open body.
The hip feint covers distance and fakes a kick; the real one goes high.

combos.cue: Fake the jab. Calf kick while they're frozen.
combos.why: The jab fake freezes their hands and front foot; the calf kick lands on the planted leg.

combos.cue: Jab, jab, and kick where they slip to.
combos.why: Two jabs make them slip outside; the lead head kick is waiting where their head goes.
The front kick to the body stops them and folds them; jab and cross land as they come back up.
Feint with the hips, then the real front kick straight to the belly.

combos.calls: feint low kick, question mark kick
combos.why: Adesanya: make it look low, change it high at the last second.
The real front kick, then the same chamber turned over to the head.

combos.cue: Front kick to back them up. The 2 follows them.
combos.why: McGregor's front kick backs them up to the fence, where the straight waits.
The jab raises their hands; the front kick folds them; the 2 lands as they come back up.

combos.cue: Stomp above the knee, then the 2.
combos.why: The oblique stomp above the knee stops their step; the 2 lands while they are stuck.
Stop the advance with the oblique kick, then snipe them while they reset.

combos.cue: Spin to cut them off. The 2 is waiting where they run.
combos.why: The spinning back kick cuts off their escape; when they circle away from it, they circle into your 2.
The wheel kick stops them moving to the centre; they turn back into the straight.
After the one two they expect a hook; turn and drive the back kick straight up the middle to the body.
Cerrone flinched at the body kick; the knee came while he defended the kick.
Ruffy's dart: one long step in, right hand, left hook, and out before they answer.
In with the right hand and straight back out: hit and don't be there.

combos.cue: Fake the jab, and let that turn become the spin.
combos.why: The UFC 313 knockout: a jab feint raises their hands for the punch and the turn of the feint becomes the wheel kick.
Spinning back kick to the body, then the spinning kick high. He dropped Chandler with that rhythm.
The lead hook already turns you clockwise; keep turning into the back kick.
Fast hands bring their guard tight; the hook turns you into the wheel kick round the side.
The right hand stumbles them and the flying knee meets them. That's how Mullarkey went.
Right, left, right, and leave. The basic Ruffy burst.
The 2 makes them shell high; the up jab comes up through the middle of the shell.
Up jab and 2 set each other up: under, over, under.
The up jab splits the guard after the one two; the last 2 goes through the gap.
Up jab lifts the chin, then cross, hook, cross while they are still looking up.
The jab raises their eyes and hands; the rear body kick lands under the elbow.
The lead hook turns your hips the right way; the rear kick comes off that turn.
Cross, hook, and the hook loads the rear body kick. Dutch style.

combos.calls: lead body kick, 2, 3, rear body kick
combos.why: Body kicks on both sides with the hands in between: they can't guard both.
Land the body kick, step down forward, and the one two follows.
The up jab lifts their guard; the lead body kick goes under it.
The cross turns your hips; the lead body kick comes off that turn to the liver.
Sprawl the shot, back up to stance, punish as they stand.
They duck under your one two for a takedown: sprawl and cross as they come up.
The low kick drops their eyes; the wheel kick comes around high.
The teep makes them rebound forward, straight into the knee.
The jab freezes their guard high; the flying knee comes from underneath.
They brace for the cross; the back kick goes into the belly.
The hook turns you; keep turning and the back fist lands on the same side.
In and out: range is the first thing you control.
Circle away from their power hand.
Change direction so they can't time you.
Step in, then turn off the line.

combos.calls: step in, step out, circle left
combos.why: In, out, and off the line.

traps.calls: 1, body 2 | 1, body 2 | 1, body 2 | body 2, rear head kick
traps.why: Three body crosses teach them to drop the elbow; the fourth goes high.
traps.ok: builds on k01 (body 2, rear head kick), Milan's favourite

traps.calls: 1, 2 | 1, 2 | 2, lead head kick
traps.why: After repeated one twos they cover high and centre; the lead kick goes around.
Three identical jabs set the rhythm; the feint breaks it and the cross lands on the flinch.

traps.calls: 1 | 1 | up jab, 2
traps.why: Straight jabs make them cover high; the up jab comes underneath on the third.

traps.calls: teep | teep | feint kick, 2
traps.why: Two teeps make them reach for the leg; fake the third and cross over the lowered hand.

traps.calls: body jab, body 2 | body jab, body 2 | body jab, 2
traps.why: Twice to the body drops their guard; the same entry goes to the head the third time.

traps.calls: low kick | low kick | 1, rear head kick
traps.why: Low kicks pull their eyes and guard down; the same leg comes up high.

traps.calls: 1, step back | 1, step back | 1, pull, 2
traps.why: Jab and step back teaches them to chase; the third time, pull and catch them chasing.

traps.calls: 1, 2, step out | 1, 2, step out | 1, 2, pull, 2
traps.why: Leaving after the one two invites them to follow; the third time you stay and counter.

traps.calls: lead body kick | lead body kick | lead head kick
traps.why: Body kicks make them drop the arm; the same kick goes upstairs. Jones did it to Cormier.
Two one twos make them shell high; the third cross goes under, to the body.

traps.calls: up jab | up jab | up jab, rear head kick
traps.why: Up jabs make them squeeze the guard tight in the middle; the head kick goes around it.

traps.calls: teep | 1, teep | 1, rear head kick
traps.why: Teeps make them guard the middle; after the jab, the kick goes high instead.

traps.calls: pull, 2 | pull, 2 | pull, lead head kick
traps.why: Twice they eat the pull counter and cover for the cross; the third answer is the kick.

traps.calls: 1, 2, 3, low kick | 1, 2, 3, low kick | 1, 2, 3, rear head kick
traps.why: Dutch style: they learn to check after the punches; now the same kick goes high.

traps.calls: feint 1 | feint 1 | 1, 2
traps.why: Feints with no follow-up teach them to ignore it; the next one is real.

traps.calls: calf kick | calf kick | feint kick, 2
traps.why: Calf kicks make them lift the leg early; fake it and cross while they stand on one foot.
Each combo adds a strike; they defend the last pattern, not the new one.

traps.calls: 1, pull | 1, pull | 1, pull, 2
traps.why: Two empty pulls make them commit to the counter; the third time it's waiting for them.

traps.calls: feint 2 | feint 2 | 1, body 2
traps.why: Cross feints make them cover their face; the real cross goes to the body.

traps.calls: front kick | front kick | question mark kick
traps.why: Two real front kicks to the body teach them to drop the hands; the third chambers the same and turns over to the head.

traps.calls: feint 1, calf kick | feint 1, calf kick | feint 1, 2
traps.why: After two calf kicks they lift the leg on every jab fake; the third time the 2 lands on a man standing on one foot.

traps.calls: 1 | 1 | 1, lead head kick
traps.why: Jabs teach them to slip outside; the third time the kick is waiting where they slip.

traps.calls: shoulder feint | hip feint | shoulder feint, rear head kick
traps.why: Feints with nothing behind them teach them to stop reacting; then the real kick comes off the same look.

traps.calls: front kick, 2 | front kick, 2 | front kick, back kick
traps.why: Front kick and straight walks them to the fence; the third time the spinning back kick lands as they brace for the straight.

traps.calls: rear body kick | rear body kick | feint kick, 2
traps.why: Two body kicks and they flinch at any kick; fake it and the 2 lands on the flinch.

traps.calls: 1, step out | 1, step out | 1, hop back, 2
traps.why: Jab and leave twice so they start to chase; the third time back-skip and counter as they come.

traps.calls: 1, 2 | 1, 2 | feint 1, wheel kick
traps.why: One twos make them raise the hands at any jab; the feint does the rest and the wheel kick goes round the guard.

traps.calls: step in, 2, step out | step in, 2, step out | step in, 2, 3, back kick
traps.why: Darting in and out makes them wait for the exit; this time keep turning into the back kick.

defence.why: Parry the jab with the rear hand; the lead hand is free, so jab straight back, then cross.
Lean back just enough for the jab to fall short, then cross over it.
Slip outside the jab; your cross is loaded on that side.
Step out of range, then come back as they recover.
After the pull your weight is back and the lead leg is free.
The cross falls short when you pull; your cross comes back while their chin is open.
Slip outside the cross and the lead hook is loaded on that side.
Take it on the shoulder and fire the cross straight back.
Pull, and hook them as their cross comes back.
Their cross is parried by your lead hand, so the rear hand is free: fire the 2 straight back.
Roll under the hook and come back with your own hook and cross.
The hook passes in front of your face; the cross goes through the middle it opened.
Glove to the temple, answer straight, and leave before the next one.
Block the rear hook; your lead hook is the shortest answer.
The overhand is long and slow: step back, let it miss, punish the gap.
Parry the jab, pull from the cross, and cross back over it.
Step back from both, then cross as they finish.
Parry both jabs with the rear hand, then jab and cross on the third beat.
Check with the lead shin and cross while they land square.
Pull the leg back so the kick misses, then cross as they swing through.
Check, then answer kick for kick.
Turn the knee out to check the calf, then cross as they land.
Check and teep straight away so they can't follow up.
Catch the body kick and cross while they hop on one leg.
Block it, then kick back on the same side while they reset.
Block high, arm tight to the head, then cross while they land.
Lean back and let it pass in front of you, then punish as they turn open.
Block with the rear arm, then jab and cross before they reset their feet.
Step back out of the arc; their hip is open as the kick passes.
Sweep the teep across with the rear hand; they turn sideways, jab and cross.
Catch the teep and cross while they balance on one leg.
Step off the line and low kick the leg they are standing on.
Back-skip out of range and land the 2 as they square up.
When they rush in, pivot as you throw the lead hook; they run into it and you are off the line.
Pull from the cross; they overextend and the lead hook catches them coming in.
Hips back and down, then back up and punish as they stand.
Pull from the rush, straight down the middle, then leave on the angle.

mc_straight.name: McGregor's straight
mc_straight.focus: McGregor's straight. The jab and the feint open the door. The 2 walks through it.
mc_straight.teach: The setup: feint the jab with your shoulder. When they flinch, two, straight down the middle. Drill it.
mc_straight.tip: Next round: McGregor's straight. Sell the jab feint, then the 2 on the flinch.
cues: Sell the feint with the shoulder, not just the hand.
The 2 starts from the back foot. Turn the hip.
Stay long. Make them reach for you.

ru_dart.name: Ruffy's in and out
ru_dart.focus: Ruffy's in and out. Long entries, right hand, left hook, and gone.
ru_dart.teach: The setup: one long step in, 2, 3, and step out before they answer. Hands can be low, feet never stop. Drill it.
ru_dart.tip: Next round: Ruffy's in and out. Long step in, 2, 3, and gone.
cues: In and out. Never stand in front of them.
Exit on an angle, not straight back.
Light on the feet between combos.

mc_pull.name: McGregor's pull counter
mc_pull.focus: McGregor's pull counter. Bait, pull, punish.
mc_pull.teach: The setup: jab, lean back just out of their answer, and fire the 2 over it. Drill it.
mc_pull.tip: Next round: McGregor's pull counter. Jab, pull, and the 2 over the top.
cues: Pull from the waist. Eyes stay on them.
Small pull, big 2.
Load the back leg on the pull, and fire off it.

ad_feints.name: Adesanya's feints into kicks
ad_feints.focus: Adesanya's feints. Feint first, kick second.
ad_feints.teach: The setup: fake the jab. While they're frozen, calf kick the front leg. Drill it.
ad_feints.tip: Next round: Adesanya's feints. Fake the jab, and kick while they're frozen.
cues: Make the feint big and the kick fast.
Never kick naked. Feint or punch first.
Watch the reaction, then kick.

ad_front.name: Front kick and question mark kick
ad_front.focus: Front kick and question mark kick. Body, body, then the head.
ad_front.teach: The setup: front kick to the body, twice. They drop their hands to catch it. The third one chambers the same and turns over to the head. Drill it.
ad_front.tip: Next round: the question mark kick. Front kick, front kick, then turn it over high.
cues: Chamber the question mark exactly like the front kick.
Turn the hip over at the last moment.
Front kick the belly button, not the chest.

mc_kicks.name: McGregor's kicks and spins
mc_kicks.focus: McGregor's kicks and spins. Kick them to the fence, cut off the exit, and the 2 is waiting.
mc_kicks.teach: The setup: front kick, 2. Twice. Then front kick and spin into the back kick while they brace for the 2. Drill it.
mc_kicks.tip: Next round: McGregor's kicks. Front kick them back, spin to cut them off, 2 where they run.
cues: Oblique kick above the knee. Stomp, don't swing.
Spin fast, and your eyes get back to the target first.
After every kick, the hands come straight back.

mc_pulldef.name: Pull counter defence
mc_pulldef.focus: Pull counter defence. They throw, you pull, you punish.
mc_pulldef.teach: The setup: when you hear incoming cross, lean back just out of range and fire your 2 straight back. Drill it.
mc_pulldef.tip: Next round: pull counters off their punches. Pull, and the 2 straight back.
cues: Pull just enough. Make it miss by an inch.
The counter comes the instant their hand is out.
Don't admire it. Reset your stance.

ad_counter.name: Adesanya's counters
ad_counter.focus: Adesanya's counters. Make them overextend, then the lead hook meets them.
ad_counter.teach: The setup: when they rush in, don't back up straight. Pivot as you throw the lead hook, and you're off the line. That's how Adesanya finished Whittaker. Drill it.
ad_counter.tip: Next round: Adesanya's counters. When they rush, check hook and pivot.
cues: Pivot on the lead foot as the hook lands.
Short hook. Elbow behind it.
Let them come to you.

ru_chaos.name: Ruffy's counters and spins
ru_chaos.focus: Ruffy's chaos. Defend, answer fast, and sometimes spin.
ru_chaos.teach: The setup: fake the jab, and let the turn of the feint become the spinning wheel kick. The King Green knockout. Drill it slow first.
ru_chaos.tip: Next round: Ruffy's spins. Fake the jab, and spin into the wheel kick.
cues: Spin on the ball of the lead foot.
Spinning stuff is rare. The 2 is still your main weapon.
After the spin, the hands come home first.

segments.say: Warm-up. Bounce on your feet, in and out. Hands start in a moment.
Hands now. Light jabs and crosses. Loose shoulders.
Add the legs. Light kicks, nothing hard yet.
Pick up the pace. Incoming calls are on.

straights.say: Straights. One two, nonstop, all out.

body.say: Two to the body, two to the head. Nonstop.

jabs.say: Jabs only. As fast as you can.

upjab.say: Up jab, two, up jab, two. Nonstop.

pull2.say: Pull and two. Pull and two. Nonstop.

hooks.say: Three, two. Hook and cross. Nonstop.

kicks.say: Body kicks. Switch legs every kick.

sprawls.say: Sprawl, back up, one two. Nonstop.

phrases.mix: Now it's mixed in. Same setup, more calls around it.
phrases.hide: Now it's hidden. When you hear it, explode.
phrases.lastMin: Last minute. Perfect reps of the setup.
phrases.rest: Rest. Breathe through the nose. Walk it off.
phrases.nextBurn: Next: the burnout. Three minutes. Twenty on, ten off.
phrases.nextTech: Next: the finisher. Slow and perfect. Today's setups, one more time.
phrases.techFinal: Final round. Slow and perfect. Exhale on every strike.
phrases.done: Session done. Good work. Rate it and log it.
cuesHard: Move your head after every combo.
cuesTech: Slow is smooth. Smooth is fast.
Check your stance after every combo.
phrases.camSetup: Camera check. Stand the phone diagonal in front of you, two to three metres away, so it sees you from head to feet. Get in your stance.
phrases.cam_noperson: I can't see you. Check the phone is pointing at you and there's light on you.
phrases.cam_nohands: I can't see your hands. Turn the phone a bit more in front of you.
phrases.cam_nofeet: I can't see your feet. Move the phone further back.
phrases.cam_nocamera: The camera isn't giving me a picture.
phrases.camGuard: Hold your normal guard. Five seconds. Don't move.
phrases.camTwos: Now three of your best twos. Really turn the hip.

phrases.camBlind: Camera check: I can't see your punches well. Point the phone at your whole body.

audit: Incoming attacks are now spoken by a second, female en-US voice as 'Incoming cross!', after an alert chirp and a forced silence. v1 said 'Cross!' in the coach voice straight after a numbered combo, which is how 'one, two, cross' happened.

k03 '1, 2, low kick' became '1, low kick' and t15 became the Dutch '1, 2, 3, low kick' pattern, for the same reason as k06. k06 '1, 2, rear body kick' became '1, 2, 3, rear body kick': straight after the cross the rear kick is not loaded (rear hand into rear leg); the lead hook reloads the hips.
k07 kept as 'feint kick, 2' (fake the kick, land the cross on the flinch).
k01 'body 2, rear head kick' kept on purpose (Milan's favourite), marked ok in the audit.
v1 rare r06 'rear head kick, wheel kick' dropped: two full spins of the same leg in a row is not something anyone sets up on purpose.
v1 rare r01 became mc07 (McGregor's spinning back kick to the body after the one two). The rest of the rare list moved into combos, capped by the spin limit.

Every offence call is checked by tools/build_library_md.py: no 'cross'/'hook' words in offence (numbers only), no doubled tokens except pumped jabs/kicks/pulls, combos end on a strike or an exit, rear hand straight into a rear kick is flagged, every token is in the known vocabulary, every source key exists.

v4: no teep-teep or double front kick inside one combo (a freestanding bag moves away after the first one); after parrying a jab with the rear hand the lead hand fires first (parry, 1, 2), and only a parried cross is answered with the 2. The audit now enforces both.
